images.prompt: A coffin-shaped black arcade cabinet seen from an elevated three-quarter angle. (2) Pink-magenta glowing claw-mark slashes cut into the right side panel, light bleeding through from inside. (3) A small blue LCD screen embedded in the chest below the dome. (4) Dark matte black wood construction with visible panel seams. (5) Small caster wheels at the base. The overall vibe is spooky-fun Halloween arcade machine meets mad scientist creation. Render as a tiny board-game miniature building, about the size of a cottage on a game board. Transparent background.
